## ASD Essential Eight: Multi-factor authentication (MFA)

Monitors MFA coverage, phishing-resistant MFA adoption (FIDO2 security keys, Windows Hello for Business, certificate-based authentication), legacy authentication usage and Conditional Access policy exclusions across Microsoft Entra ID (`SigninLogs`, `AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs`, `AuditLogs`) and Microsoft Sentinel UEBA (`IdentityInfo`).

**ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model (November 2023) summary:**
- **ML1**: MFA enforced for online services and sensitive third-party services; legacy authentication blocked.
- **ML2**: Phishing-resistant MFA enforced for online services, sensitive data repositories and all privileged users; MFA events and Conditional Access changes centrally logged.
- **ML3**: Phishing-resistant MFA enforced for all users authenticating to workstations, servers, online services and data repositories with no unapproved exclusions.

> **Disclaimer:** Independent community workbook. Not produced, endorsed or supported by ASD, ACSC or Microsoft. Refer to the [ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model](https://www.cyber.gov.au/resources-business-and-government/essential-cyber-security/essential-eight/essential-eight-maturity-model) and [Microsoft Entra authentication strengths](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/authentication/concept-authentication-strengths).

content.title: MFA posture summary (ML1 to ML3)

content.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange})
| where ResultType == '0'
| extend AuthDetailsStr = tostring(AuthenticationDetails)
| extend StrengthTier = case(
    AuthDetailsStr has_any ('FIDO2', 'Windows Hello for Business', 'Certificate-based authentication', 'Passkey'), 'Phishing-Resistant MFA (ML2/ML3)',
    AuthenticationRequirement == 'multiFactorAuthentication', 'Phishable MFA (ML1 only)',
    'Single-Factor Only (Below ML1)'
)
| summarize SignIns = count(), DistinctUsers = dcount(UserPrincipalName) by StrengthTier
| order by SignIns desc
content.title: Authentication strength distribution across successful sign-ins

content.query:
let privUsers = IdentityInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AssignedRoles) by AccountUPN
| where array_length(AssignedRoles) > 0
| project AccountUPN = tolower(AccountUPN), AssignedRoles;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange})
| where ResultType == '0'
| extend UserLower = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
| join kind=inner privUsers on $left.UserLower == $right.AccountUPN
| extend AuthDetailsStr = tostring(AuthenticationDetails)
| extend IsPhishingResistant = AuthDetailsStr has_any ('FIDO2', 'Windows Hello for Business', 'Certificate-based authentication', 'Passkey')
| where IsPhishingResistant == false
| summarize SignInCount = count(), Apps = make_set(AppDisplayName, 10), Methods = make_set(AuthenticationRequirement, 5), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by UserPrincipalName, tostring(AssignedRoles)
| order by SignInCount desc
| take 100
content.title: Privileged users authenticating without phishing-resistant MFA (E8-MFA-ML2-02)

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true SigninLogs, AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange})
| where ResultType == '0'
| where ClientAppUsed in~ ('IMAP4', 'POP3', 'SMTP', 'Exchange ActiveSync', 'Exchange Web Services', 'Autodiscover', 'MAPI Over HTTP', 'Other clients')
| summarize SignInCount = count(), DistinctIPs = dcount(IPAddress), Apps = make_set(AppDisplayName, 5), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by UserPrincipalName, ClientAppUsed
| order by SignInCount desc
| take 100
content.title: Successful legacy authentication sign-ins (E8-MFA-ML1-03)

content.query:
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange})
| where Category == 'Policy'
| where OperationName has 'conditional access'
| mv-expand Target = TargetResources
| extend PolicyName = tostring(Target.displayName)
| extend ModifiedProps = tostring(Target.modifiedProperties)
| extend HasExclusionChange = ModifiedProps has_any ('excludeUsers', 'excludeGroups', 'excludeRoles', 'excludeApplications')
| extend Actor = coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName))
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, PolicyName, Actor, HasExclusionChange, Result, ModifiedProps
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Conditional Access policy changes and exclusions (E8-MFA-ML2-03, E8-MFA-ML3-01)
